Name: Low Hp Effects
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]Low HP Effects[/color][color=#f4f4f4] Mod[/color][/b] [b]enhances [/b][color=#f4f4f4]the player's[/color] [color=#f4f4f4]experience[/color]in Stardew Valley by introducing[b][color=#00ffff] immersive visual[/color][/b] and [color=#00ffff][b]gameplay effects[/b][/color] ([b][color=#ff0000]blooded vision [/color]or [color=#ff0000]red border[/color][/b], [color=#ff0000][b]heartbeat [/b][/color]and [color=#ff0000][b]controller rumble[/b][/color]) tied to the player's [color=#ff0000][b]health level[/b][/color]![/size][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/2SfcXrMN/03-12-2024-12-18-online-video-cutter-com-1.gif[/img]
[size=5][b][i]The volume of the [color=#ff0000]heartbeat[/color] is assigned to the volume of the [color=#ff0000]ambient sounds[/color]!

If for some reason you want to disable any of the functions, you can do it using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]genericmodmenu[/url]﻿
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/G29jcYd6/config.png[/img]﻿
[/i][/b][/size]


[size=3]Below 40% HP, the camera begins to shake slightly, with the intensity increasing as health decreases further. The heart begins to beat audibly, with the sound getting louder and faster as HP decreases. A red overlay gradually intensifies on the screen as the player's HP decreases from 40% to 10%.


[/size][size=6]Check my other [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Zexu2K/mods]mods[/url]﻿ for stardew valley![/size][/center]
